title: bardolier up output
description: What `bardolier up` started. cli-spec.md §6 (Projects). Additive changes only once the app ships (Phase 5+).

already_running.description: True when up was an idempotent no-op (§2).

compose_regenerated.description: True when the compose file on disk differed from the manifest.

app_port.description: Host port the archetype's dev server is published on (cli-spec.md §9), or null when this project publishes none. Additive since Phase 9.

app_url.description: Ready-to-open URL for app_port, or null when there is no dev-server port.

open_shell.description: The app's cue to open a shell; false under --no-shell. The CLI spawns no terminal.

extra_ports.description: Extra ports published alongside app_port (cli-spec.md §5.1), sorted by name. Additive since Phase 12.
